messages:
maria: created rc build rc-20260320-1 from main, artifact tag: r20260320-1. asking for quick signoffs and a pin for promo window (16:00 UTC). release notes below.

deploy-bot: build finished ✅
image: registry.redwood.ai/runtime:sha256:3a7f9b...
artifact: rc-20260320-1
checks: unit-tests ok, e2e-smoke ok, canary-health ok

tim: do we have any db migrations in this rc?
alex: no schema changes. only inference runtime tweaks and a small batching opt. safe for rolling.

sasha: kv-cache warm plan? last time cold KV killed the first 5% canary.
maria: plan is pre-warm job + staged traffic. running prewarm now (job id prewarm-4267).

maria: release notes (short):
- runtime: reduce decode memory during batching (lower p50 latency)
- model-handler: fix rare OOM on long-seq requests
- ops: add retry on grpc clients in route-fallback

maria: rollback procedure (if smoke fails):
```
# rollback to previous prod image
kubectl set image deploy/inference runtime=registry.redwood.ai/runtime:prod-20260318-5
# or use deploy-bot rollback command
/deploy rollback --to prod-20260318-5 --reason "smoke failures"
```

deploy-bot: pin request acknowledged. artifact pinned to promo window 16:00 UTC. pin id: pin-4267.

tim: +1. I will be on-call during the window.
alex: +1 :shipit: please ensure fallback model variant is configured (small-llama fallback).
sasha: +1, request post-deploy KV warm verification and steady-state qps check (I'll run).

maria: thanks. scheduling cut at 16:00 UTC. public change window noted. invoking deploybot promote 15:55 UTC for warm start.

deploy-bot: received promote command. will start prewarm at 15:55 UTC then canary ramp at 16:00 UTC -> 10% -> 50% -> 100% with 5m holds. notifications posted in this thread.

deploy-bot: 16:05 UTC - canary 10% started. health checks: initial latencies within expected band.

maria: watching logs + telemetry. if errors spike -> abort and rollback. set deadman if >5% error rate for 3m.

deploy-bot: 16:12 UTC - smoke checks: PASSED. no elevated errors. continuing ramp to 50%.

alex: noted. leaving post-approve comment in release-notes: "Ops: monitor KV warm times during next 24h."

sasha: post-deploy KV warm check: cold hits <1s and steady-state hit latencies stable. all good.

maria: promo complete. thanks team. :tada:

deploy-bot: final status: rollout complete to prod. promo pin pin-4267 -> released. metrics summary: p50 latency -3ms, error rate unchanged.

maria: will open a short follow-up with canary metrics + notes for the changelog.
